name: perxona-connect
description: Give your AI agent a face: build talking 3D avatar apps with Perxona Connect Kit (<sv-presenter> and the Connect API).

interface.longDescription:
Perxona Connect Kit gives an AI agent a face: a 3D avatar that speaks any text with lip-sync, emotion and gestures. This plugin adds one skill that helps you build web apps with it, using the <sv-presenter> web component and the Perxona Connect API.

Ask for a single HTML page where an avatar welcomes visitors, a React component that speaks each reply from your chat route, or the prompts for a Lovable app. The skill walks you through creating a Perxona account and the API keys your app needs, and where each key goes. It covers the order the avatar starts up in, unlocking sound from a click, connecting your own LLM or a Perxona chatbot, and the errors to handle.

It is for developers and hackathon builders adding a talking avatar to a website or an AI agent, and for people building with a no-code tool such as Lovable.

Limitations: the plugin contains instructions only. It does not call Perxona services, store data or run code; the code it writes does that once you run it. You need a Perxona account and a Connect API key from console.perxona.ai. Chat previews usually cannot load the avatar engine, so for HTML you get a complete file to download and open in a browser. While helping you, the skill reads public files from the kit's GitHub repository so the code matches the kit.
defaultPrompt: Build an HTML page where a talking 3D avatar welcomes visitors to my bakery.
Add a Perxona avatar to my React app that speaks each reply from my chat API.
Write the Lovable prompts for a 3D interview coach that talks.

publication.release_notes: First release: the perxona-connect skill for building web apps with a talking 3D avatar from Perxona Connect Kit.
